title: Will Mamdani sign above 0 executive orders between Oct 11, 2026 and Oct 17, 2026?
rules: If the number of non-emergency executive orders signed by Zohran Mamdani is above 0 from Oct 11, 2026 to Oct 17, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

blind.reasoning: After a burst of executive orders in January 2026, Mamdani has signed non-emergency orders on roughly 7-8 separate days in about 32 weeks (Feb-mid Sept). That is roughly 0.23 signing days per week, which gives about a 20% chance of at least one in a given 7-day window. Emergency orders, which NYC mayors issue far more often, don't count.
blind.falsifier: A Mayor's Office release showing a new numbered (non-emergency) executive order dated between Oct 11 and Oct 17, 2026, e.g., one tied to a policy rollout that week.

final.reasoning: The market's 15.5% sits close to my 20% estimate, which comes from Mamdani signing non-emergency orders on roughly 0.23 days per week since February. My research didn't cover whether anything has been signed since mid-September or is scheduled for that week, so I move toward the market. At 18% versus a 16-cent ask, the edge is too thin to act on.
